subject: mathematics
content: Let $${P_1}:\overrightarrow r \,.\,\left( {2\widehat i + \widehat j - 3\widehat k} \right) = 4$$ be a plane. Let P2 be another plane which passes through the points (2, $$-$$3, 2), (2, $$-$$2, $$-$$3) and (1, $$-$$4, 2). If the direction ratios of the line of intersection of P1 and P2 be 16, $$\alpha$$, $$\beta$$, then the value of $$\alpha$$ + $$\beta$$ is equal to ________________.
